UnitAbilities.Title: Unto the Anvil
UnitAbilities.Text:
This unit’s melee attacks can:
▪ Re-roll wound rolls of 1.
▪ Or: If the assault doctrine is active for this unit, re-roll wound rolls.

UnitAbilities.Title: Lord of the Pyroclasts
UnitAbilities.Text: While an enemy unit is engaged with this unit, that enemy unit has -1 OC.

UnitAbilities.Title: Forgefather
UnitAbilities.Text: In your Shooting phase, select one visible enemy unit within 24" of this model. Friendly Adeptus Astartes units’ [Melta]/[Torrent] attacks that target that enemy unit have +2 S.

UnitAbilities.Title: Seeker of the Unfound
UnitAbilities.Text:
The first time this model is set up on the battlefield, select one objective on the battlefield. While this model is within range of that objective, this model has:
▪ 10 OC.
▪ 5+ Ld.
▪ Feel No Pain 4+.

AddedAbilities.Title: SEEKER’S COMPANIONS
AddedAbilities.Text:
During your turn, this unit is eligible to do one of the following:
▪ Start to perform an Action in a turn in which it Advanced.
▪ Shoot in a turn in which it started to perform an Action.

Rule.Restrictions: Your army can include Salamanders units, but it cannot include any Adeptus Astartes units drawn from any other Chapter.
Rule.Title: VULKAN'S QUEST
Rule.Text:
▪ You can select the devastator doctrine one additional time per battle.
▪ Friendly Adeptus Astartes units’ ranged attacks that target a unit within 12", have +1 S.
If your army includes a Vulkan He’stan unit, friendly Infernus Squad units have the following:
▪ When this unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move, that advance/fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to start an action.
▪ When this unit starts an action, that action does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot.
Restrictions: Your army can include Salamanders units, but it cannot include any Adeptus Astartes units drawn from any other Chapter.

Stratagems.Name: Wrath And Ruin
Stratagems.Target: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit.
Stratagems.Effect: The assault doctrine or tactical doctrine is active for your unit, until the start of your next Command phase.

Stratagems.Name: Blazing Earth
Stratagems.When: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
Stratagems.Target: One friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes unit equipped with one or more Torrent/Melta weapons.
Stratagems.Effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.

Stratagems.Name: Immolation Protocols
Stratagems.When: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes infantry unit is selected to attack.
Stratagems.Effect: Your unit’s ranged [TORRENT] attacks have +1 AP.

Stratagems.Name: Burning Vengeance
Stratagems.When: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot a friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport unit.
Stratagems.Target: One friendly Adeptus Astartes unit embarked within that Adeptus Astartes Transport unit.
Stratagems.Effect:
Your Adeptus Astartes unit can:
Make a disembark move.Shoot using normal shooting, but when doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

Stratagems.Name: Crucible Of Battle
Stratagems.When: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes infantry unit is selected to attack an enemy unit within 6".
Stratagems.Effect:
Your unit’s attacks can:
Re-roll hit rolls of 1.Re-roll wound rolls of 1.

Stratagems.Name: Forged In Fire
Stratagems.When: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged Adeptus Astartes unit is selected to shoot.
Stratagems.Effect:
Your unit’s Torrent weapons:
Do not have [Blast].Have [Close-Quarters].Have +1 A.

ArmyRules.Title: OATH OF MOMENT
ArmyRules.Text:
If your Army Faction is Adeptus Astartes, at the start of your Command phase, select one unit from your opponent’s army. Until the start of your next Command phase, that enemy unit is your Oath of Moment target. Each time a model with this ability makes an attack that targets your Oath of Moment target:
	▪ You can re-roll the Hit roll.
	▪ If you are using a Codex: Space Marines Detachment and your army does not include one or more units with the Blood Angels, Dark Angels, Deathwatch or Space Wolves keywords, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

ArmyRules.Title: SPACE MARINE CHAPTERS
ArmyRules.Text:
▪ If an Adeptus Astartes unit has a second Faction keyword on its datasheet, that Faction keyword is the name of that unit’s Chapter. For example, Marneus Calgar has both the Adeptus Astartes and Ultramarines Faction keywords, and is therefore from the Ultramarines Chapter.

	▪ You cannot include units from more than one Chapter in your army.

	▪ If your army includes one or more Black Templars units, it cannot include any Adeptus Astartes Psyker models, and cannot include any of the following models that do not have the Black Templars keyword: Gladiator Lancer; Gladiator Reaper; Gladiator Valiant; Impulsor; Repulsor; Repulsor Executioner.

	▪ If your army includes one or more Space Wolves units, it cannot include any of the following units: Apothecary; Devastator Squad; Tactical Squad.

Deathwatch
	▪ Your army can include Adeptus Astartes Deathwatch units, but it cannot include any Adeptus Astartes units drawn from any other Chapter.

	▪ With the exception of Kill Team Cassius (see Legends: Agents of the Imperium), your army cannot include any Agents of the Imperium Deathwatch units.

	▪ Your army cannot include any of the following units: Assault Squad; Assault Squad with Jump Packs; Attack Bike Squad; Devastator Squad; Land Speeder Storm; Relic Terminator Squad; Scout Bike Squad; Scout Squad; Scout Sniper Squad; Tactical Squad; Terminator Assault Squad; Terminator Squad.
